# THE ONREPEAT — Premium Apparel Brand from India

> THE ONREPEAT is a premium apparel brand from India, founded in 2024 by Paras Soni.
> Tagline: A garment is not merely a covering, but a story of emotions.
> Sanskrit: वस्त्रं न केवलम् आच्छादनम्, अपितु भावकथा।
> Brand philosophy: From Zero to Infinite.
> Brand name ONREPEAT (शून्य) = Zero — the space from which all creation begins.
> Wordmark: SUन्य (Latin SU + Devanagari न्य).
> Inspired by Sanskrit philosophy, fifth-century Indian art, and modern street culture.
> 10,000+ orders delivered. Rated 4.7 out of 5.
> Featured in The Tribune, The Print, WBN and other Indian press outlets.
> Construction: German Threading — precision-calibrated stitch pattern for maximum durability.

- Shipping: Free shipping across India, 3–7 business days

## Materials
- Hoodies: 320–350 GSM brushed-back cotton fleece, made in India
- Sweatshirts: 240–280 GSM cotton blend, soft-brushed interior, made in India
- T-shirts: 240 GSM premium Supima cotton, pre-shrunk single jersey, made in India
- Shirts: 180 GSM long-staple cotton, German-threaded seams, made in India
- Print methods: water-based soft-hand inks, sublimation dye, discharge ink, tonal embroidery
- Construction: German Threading throughout — precision stitching for durability

## Audience
- India, ages 18–32, urban / metro
- Premium apparel at accessible prices (₹999–₹2,999)
